# Introduction

This vignette shows how to create a SummarizedExperiment object from a CSV file.

The important steps are: 

1. load counts and metadata stored into CSV files

2. make a SummarizedExperiment object and store the count-matrix into an assay named "counts". 
   This is a standard assay name, and many package rely on this default name so it simplify further processing.
   
3. set rownames to unique gene symbol

5. pre-computing of QC metrics and sizeFactors

6. store object into desired format 


```{r,message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```


# Example with GEO dataset GSE190012
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE213828 

```{r}
count_m <- read.delim("apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE213828/GSE213828_merged_counts.txt.gz")
metaD <- read.delim("apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE213828/GSE213828_merged_sample_info.txt.gz",row.names = "qp_well_fq")
o <- SingleCellExperiment(
  list(counts = data.matrix(count_m[,-1:-2])),
  rowData = count_m[,1:2],
  colData = metaD,
  mainExpName = "Gene Expression"
)
rownames(o) <- make.unique(mcols(o)$gene_name)
```

The SingleCellEperiment object is ready to use.


## step 5: pre-compute QC metrics and sizeFactors
```{r}
o <- scater::addPerCellQC(o)
o <- scuttle::computeLibraryFactors(o)
```


#Save object

```{r}
HDF5Array::saveHDF5SummarizedExperiment(o,"datasets/GSE213828.h5se")
ABAData::writeSingleCellExperiment(o, "datasets/GSE213828.h5txt")
```
